nodes.label: Connection Tab/Title Label Line
nodes.rationale: Environment tier, read-only status, and version are appended to the connection name as a single line in the tab text and window title (Name TIER lock READ-ONLY [version]) rather than a separate workspace banner, so identity, environment, read-only status, and server version read together; Unclassified is the one exception, omitted entirely so pre-existing profiles look unchanged; read-only uses the same lock-and-text treatment regardless of tier since the toggle is independent of environment; these labels are safety aids and do not replace database-level permissions or enforcement.
